Alcohol significantly alters your body's normal metabolic processes because the liver treats ethanol as a priority toxin that must be broken down immediately.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-1Qao2FaWgztd8-BRwDXgrxYG_fESt0X1qIivRlYLAPpD7colXXRzNZ-3-toTQo8eK4vzmsQ9gxRxIv0y-IouHzFhjpzZeeMx1dDpkWEMi8QWagvpybMDQwfJsrHmg6HR5b4JDR4YPdkC7Rn0wt6dAu_rUK1-TX0PeZ19cyiKDo7-evi0PplYlGTGvgg8Hy1A)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tSokvhMdfFI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESogEBxCJF1xmetlyX1XJGtunotzaULUPyR54wGQJ86MkM3RE8K93aVy_GjnbJuDnKxAehHc-Jg85EZvaqcNJ__46uFRUXHtUTDQcTULeG9bfT0ynEntHE3j65SIGLrV9Oyf684KWsJshvMkgG1q8qI3t3msvN-FdxX2mYmHuvracrWPVvGjYyQ8N6xVxJkHwBFyL9fUhp0jAkI8JaXFgyXOLQaTY)

### How the Liver Processes Alcohol

- **High Calorie Density:** Alcohol provides about **7.1 calories per gram** (nearly double the calories of protein or carbohydrates), yet it offers no essential nutrients, vitamins, or minerals (often called "empty calories").[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXwaX6PSI_sQoO9PE-_O1DSMOXeZ_qygh7ztPZfY3LgSK100EmFWStiOScV0LYSwL9DlW5mYsPd68m9GNUX-Px0Df9_f7-4d-U4LDDkg-YhAOYTh3EiVjB54l8jXOqUJ0DZYKTu7WF8ZqS)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/foundmyfitness/videos/why-alcohol-facilitates-weight-gain-and-specifically-an-increase-in-visceral-fat/489252013713047/)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wb8kCSBZBkA69Nc11weQ8Dy3vRNsWZR6kEVFiykhTkNoyVixRE7AStoGP5-X_7zyCrJvIItfkLjFZA75qx4NxuVI1tcyDn6pfMxCSMD00DDuZtHXp5lQJ4OozrFklJsbG_XHMtsaPlFmWlKePZ6XPXBibVoSDR0IwBfX-wZsp91)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xkn-dmYUhOI)
- **Priority Clearance:** Because the body cannot store alcohol, the liver stops processing other fuel sources—such as dietary fats and carbohydrates—to break down ethanol first.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF10mXIOYKLF6dIf3sKsJ9tGHohVZtWw2w4nYFH8ya9T04T7eV5MZG4UqtKp11jLc75Kfy6zskKzr9_44UlPWfx7hilAtXPwdIvXBwd2ZBh2wGiCjsjTS33Bcw3FdoZbOwvnJqLlDE-kjlx2CJ_g0kx3bo5YoOscWCdbqtXvPiu8mYB_lNWKpnviNNW-D03HJ4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tSokvhMdfFI)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/tamsenfadal/posts/did-you-know-that-as-soon-as-you-drink-alcohol-your-body-stops-burning-fat-i-def/1565093821646807/)
- **The Breakdown Pathway:** The liver converts alcohol into **acetaldehyde** (a toxic compound), which is then converted into **acetate** , and finally into water and carbon dioxide.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BWQ1-UG9cV8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-1Qao2FaWgztd8-BRwDXgrxYG_fESt0X1qIivRlYLAPpD7colXXRzNZ-3-toTQo8eK4vzmsQ9gxRxIv0y-IouHzFhjpzZeeMx1dDpkWEMi8QWagvpybMDQwfJsrHmg6HR5b4JDR4YPdkC7Rn0wt6dAu_rUK1-TX0PeZ19cyiKDo7-evi0PplYlGTGvgg8Hy1A)
- **Timeline:** It takes the body roughly **1 hour per standard drink** to metabolize alcohol, meaning a night of drinking can pause normal fat oxidation (fat burning) for many hours or even up to a full day or more.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF19yB6dT4yJYolEvvZT_XJLgYdRwHKo1NEvtMa8FiVxgC7HzTyaau-3VtbbRLGTD6VTkHW8kUsqWH9EvmUKeBm3FGerlvTtaliL73tCaJJzLBDZsUba3kjAtxWXRZuCe6jbgIHf-w9sbI3yx59JRDFJRzPCKVNiimmVo_378sy6OYK6lJyA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xkn-dmYUhOI)

### Impact on Hormones and Fat Storage

- **Shifted Energy Balance:** The metabolic breakdown of alcohol alters cellular energy ratios (shifting NAD+ to NADH), which signals the body to store fatty acids rather than burn them.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BWQ1-UG9cV8)
- **Increased Appetite:** Alcohol disrupts appetite-regulating hormones and lowers inhibitions, frequently triggering cravings for high-calorie, fatty, or salty foods.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF15N9i77j35gtA8cdXrD41iEYvOL_N4c-sIkAH_DgSn-pd_YTS-Cmp_4Xk3zZkvWPlRzVv_1Mh0HmM23IsMBv4kzWJx496zdnDI1-lvAUn4633s7yHyWEQw8GvzPpiShGCrtSwQU65Vby27A-LYERcpm1pixjUUsUVHdhPYYqNiC-Pcsif9f_M6U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-1Qao2FaWgztd8-BRwDXgrxYG_fESt0X1qIivRlYLAPpD7colXXRzNZ-3-toTQo8eK4vzmsQ9gxRxIv0y-IouHzFhjpzZeeMx1dDpkWEMi8QWagvpybMDQwfJsrHmg6HR5b4JDR4YPdkC7Rn0wt6dAu_rUK1-TX0PeZ19cyiKDo7-evi0PplYlGTGvgg8Hy1A)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RQfN6hYOKyk)
- **Hormonal and Sleep Disruption:** Drinking interferes with sleep quality, raises **cortisol** (stress hormone) levels, and can suppress testosterone or growth hormone output, which collectively slows down overall metabolic efficiency.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1wb8kCSBZBkA69Nc11weQ8Dy3vRNsWZR6kEVFiykhTkNoyVixRE7AStoGP5-X_7zyCrJvIItfkLjFZA75qx4NxuVI1tcyDn6pfMxCSMD00DDuZtHXp5lQJ4OozrFklJsbG_XHMtsaPlFmWlKePZ6XPXBibVoSDR0IwBfX-wZsp91)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RQfN6hYOKyk)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/tamsenfadal/posts/did-you-know-that-as-soon-as-you-drink-alcohol-your-body-stops-burning-fat-i-def/1565093821646807/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tSokvhMdfFI)
- **Abdominal Fat ("Beer Belly"):** Because fat burning is halted while the body clears alcohol, any calories consumed simultaneously from food or mixers are more likely to be stored as body fat, particularly around the midsection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF19yB6dT4yJYolEvvZT_XJLgYdRwHKo1NEvtMa8FiVxgC7HzTyaau-3VtbbRLGTD6VTkHW8kUsqWH9EvmUKeBm3FGerlvTtaliL73tCaJJzLBDZsUba3kjAtxWXRZuCe6jbgIHf-w9sbI3yx59JRDFJRzPCKVNiimmVo_378sy6OYK6lJyA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF10mXIOYKLF6dIf3sKsJ9tGHohVZtWw2w4nYFH8ya9T04T7eV5MZG4UqtKp11jLc75Kfy6zskKzr9_44UlPWfx7hilAtXPwdIvXBwd2ZBh2wGiCjsjTS33Bcw3FdoZbOwvnJqLlDE-kjlx2CJ_g0kx3bo5YoOscWCdbqtXvPiu8mYB_lNWKpnviNNW-D03HJ4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tSokvhMdfFI)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/tamsenfadal/posts/did-you-know-that-as-soon-as-you-drink-alcohol-your-body-stops-burning-fat-i-def/1565093821646807/)[[5]](https://www.facebook.com/foundmyfitness/videos/why-alcohol-facilitates-weight-gain-and-specifically-an-increase-in-visceral-fat/489252013713047/)
